verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out control: no flag, setting, or environment variable to disable data collection. The 'private by default / offline' positioning and an unverified HN reply saying 'no data is collected' describe a privacy posture, not a documented opt-out mechanism. The hosted Wally cloud explicitly tracks usage (`wally account usage`), and nothing shows that tracking can be disabled.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
